comparison.objective: Install a 2.5-inch SSD in a tool-less carrier; candidate sets and locks the gripper's opening limit.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sprung rail open while aligning a thin drive and four side holes with pins, then release the rail; candidate counterholds a screw while tightening a nut with separate tools.
comparison.success_condition: All four pins engaged, rail closed, drive flat and correctly oriented, stable for one second; earlier versions also penalize falls or wrong orientation.
comparison.reason: Spring-rail retention and multi-pin insertion test constrained assembly alignment, not coupled threaded calibration or retained functional cycling.
